decisionScope: Stable release approval, not automated code quality.

gates.subject: 100+ independently annotated real held-out passage events, two directions, standard-condition Precision and Recall at least 95%
Actual Windows Chrome/Edge camera and physical end-to-end path, not synthetic camera alone
Physical Android Chrome fixed-camera counting, correction/Undo, exports and interruptions
Physical iPhone Safari fixed-camera counting, correction/Undo, exports and interruptions
Authoritative license/redistribution permission for exact EfficientDet-Lite0 int8 .tflite
Confirm license/NOTICE copy distribution alongside the independent single HTML
Cloudflare live preview HTTP CSP headers and final production header compatibility

notes: v0.10.0 is a pre-release camera-first UX and A/B line interaction improvement; its CI is not a substitute for physical devices or field accuracy.
The line centre translates both endpoints together, preserving length and angle; each endpoint adjusts independently.
An empty region of the camera should remain scrollable on mobile; line and handle gestures use isolated touch hit regions.
A successful GitHub Actions run proves the listed automatic checks, not field accuracy.
The three-event synthetic scoring example must never count as human-labeled field evidence.
The repo's model.config.json license declaration alone does not establish a model-specific redistribution grant.
The v0.9 branch remains a draft until all blocking gates are independently reviewed.
